text: 分众传媒公告称，公司拟以发行股份及支付现金方式收购成都新潮传媒集团股份有限公司股权，近日收到国家市场监督管理总局附加限制性条件批准本次经营者集中的反垄断审查决定。附加义务包括继续履行现有客户合同、保持服务水平、年度实际成交价不得超过生效前24个月对应城市价格、公平无歧视提供服务、放弃点位独家条款权利且新签续签不得约定独家及自动续约条款、完善反垄断合规制度等。限制性条件5年期满后可申请解除，本次交易尚需深交所审核、证监会同意注册等审批，存在不确定性。
text_en: Focus Media announced that the company plans to acquire equity in Chengdu Xinchao Media Group Co., Ltd. through the issuance of shares and cash payment. It recently received the anti-monopoly review decision from the State Administration for Market Regulation approving the concentration of undertakings with restrictive conditions attached. The additional obligations include continuing to perform existing customer contracts, maintaining service levels, annual actual transaction prices not exceeding the corresponding city prices in the 24 months before effectiveness, providing services fairly and without discrimination, waiving the right to exclusive site terms and not stipulating exclusivity or automatic renewal clauses in new or renewed contracts, and improving anti-monopoly compliance systems. The restrictive conditions can be applied for release after the 5-year period expires. This transaction still requires Shenzhen Stock Exchange review and CSRC approval for registration, and there is uncertainty.
